provenance.summary: Compact curated French core lexicon. Not a corpus frequency list: `rank` is global list order (A1, then A2, then B1) and is a coarse frequency proxy only.
provenance.function_words: Seeded from spaCy's French stop-word list (spacy.lang.fr.stop_words.STOP_WORDS, MIT licence, already a dependency of this repo), reduced by hand to lemmas.
provenance.content_words: Hand-curated against the CEFR band descriptors and this app's own A1/A2 journey scenarios. No proprietary word list was copied.
provenance.forms: Irregular surface->lemma pairs only. Regular inflection is handled by the suffix rules in app/services/lexical_coverage.py.
provenance.licence: Curated for this repository; free to redistribute with it.
provenance.content_words_v2: Built 2026-09-23 (WP-L2): content words extended to ~2,500 lemmas through B1 by an LLM draft from general knowledge of French frequency and CEFR course-book vocabulary (A1-B1 reference descriptions, DELF-style themes). No dataset or word list was copied. Human review pending.
provenance.sub_band: Every lemma carries a sub_band (A1.1, A1.2, A2.1, A2.2, B1.1, B1.2) consistent with its band: A1.1 survival/self-introduction/numbers/function words; A1.2 daily routine, home, city, weather, body, clothes, leisure; A2 past narration, travel, housing, shopping, work, health, feelings; B1 opinion, argument, society, media, environment, administration, abstract nouns. v1 lemmas kept their band; ranks were renumbered to keep one global list order after appending new words to each band.
provenance.forms_v2: v2 adds irregular forms for the new verbs (and fills gaps for a few v1 verbs such as courir, rire, craindre, asseoir, prévoir, changer, lever), irregular feminines (fraîche, sèche, publique, complète) and hyphenated plurals (grands-parents). Generated from conjugation classes, then filtered so only forms the suffix rules cannot resolve are stored.
provenance.numbers: 2026-09-23: compound numbers 17–99 (traditional and 1990 hyphenation), hundreds and thousands in 1990 spelling, added on owner request (A1.1 < 70 ≤ A1.2).
provenance.gender: 2026-09-24 (WP-S2): grammatical gender (and pos=noun) added to the A1-A2 nouns La Forge's item bank uses (app/data/grammar_templates/lexicon.json). Nouns without a gender field have not been annotated yet.
